rule.statement: A bona fide buyer's proprietary rights should not be invalidated under the pretext of a constructive trust.
rule.supporting_quote: I am of the view that the plaintiff, who is not the person against whom the constructive trust is claimed by the 1st and 2nd defendants, is a bona fide buyer whose proprietary rights should not be allowed to be invalidated under the pretext of a constructive trust as claimed by the 1st and 2nd defendants.
